champion.tips: ELISE TIPS AND TRICKS You can use your E to get over the Baron and Dragon pits in attempts to steal the objective. Just make sure it’s not warded so the enemy knows you’re there. Get as close as you can to the enemy before using your E for a guaranteed stun. The further away you’re from the enemy, the easier it will be for them to dodge. When approaching a new camp, make sure you’re in human form. Once you’ve used both your Q and W , change into Spider form to finish the camp off.
champion.builds: THE BEST ELISE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Elise Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Coup de Grace and Triumph in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Stormsurge as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Shadowflame. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff and finish with Banshee's Veil. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 51.6% winrate over 8 461 matches played. Optional Your second option for Elise Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Electrocute as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Nimbus Cloak with Waterwalking in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Stormsurge, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Shadowflame as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff and Banshee's Veil. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 50.9% win rate over 2 894 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Lich Bane as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Shadowflame as a third item. You want to finish the build with Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 55.7% win rate across 1 670 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Elise Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Sixth Sense with Relentless Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Liandry's Torment as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Stormsurge as third item. The last 3 options are Zhonya's Hourglass, Shadowflame and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.8% win rate over 292 matches played. Situational Elise Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Elise build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Elise runes page.
